result.instructions: Tools for StaffSavvy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on shift at our main venue tomorrow?"; "List the absences booked for this month."; "Show the time entries for group 5 since 1 January 2026.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StaffSavvy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run staffsavvy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run staffsavvy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run staffsavvy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. staffsavvy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: staffsavvy_get_info
tools.title: Get StaffSavvy version
tools.description: Return the StaffSavvy software version and API version for this instance. A good first call to check the connection. API: GET /api/v1/info.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List shifts on the rota: start and end times, the account, group, venue and task. Filter by event or by field, e.g. start=gte:2026-01-01. API: GET /api/v1/shifts.

filters.description: Field filters sent as query keys, e.g. {"group": "5"} or {"start": "gte:2026-01-01"}. Operators: not:, gt:, lt:, gte:, lte:.

tools.name: staffsavvy_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: Return one shift by its numeric id. API: GET /api/v1/shifts/{shiftid}.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List recorded time entries (worked hours): start, end, account, group, venue and pay element. Filter by event or by field. API: GET /api/v1/time-entries.

filters.description: Field filters sent as query keys, e.g. {"group": "5"} or {"start": "gte:2026-01-01"}. Operators: not:, gt:, lt:, gte:, lte:.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.name: see_who_is_on_shift_at_a_venue
prompts.title: See who is on shift at a venue
prompts.description: List the shifts for a date range, with the staff account, group and venue of each shift. List the venues and groups to match their names.

prompts.name: review_worked_hours_for_a_group
prompts.title: Review worked hours for a group
prompts.description: List the recorded time entries since a date, filtered by group or another field. Each entry shows its start, end, venue and pay element.

prompts.name: check_the_absences_booked_for_a_month
prompts.title: Check the absences booked for a month
prompts.description: List the absence periods with their dates. Read the absence types to name each one, such as holiday or sickness.

prompts.name: look_up_one_shift_by_its_id
prompts.title: Look up one shift by its id
prompts.description: Check the connection with the version call. Then read one shift by its numeric id.

prompts.name: list_staff_accounts_and_their_levels
prompts.title: List staff accounts and their levels
prompts.description: List staff accounts with names, contact details and levels. The results include personal data about staff, so share them only with people who need them.
